The review found 53 of 82 delivered HARD items overclassified and 37 of 116 MEDIUM items easy, so production necessarily moves past it: nineteen structures demoted out of HARD, ten out of MEDIUM, one promotion correcting a factually wrong rationale, and two splits. Kept so Holdout E's provenance stays checkable.

archived, not invalidated: this is the RC2.5 human-calibrated engine, sound and frozen after the Holdout E verdicts were applied. It reported an honest coverage shortfall — 17 hard structures could not fill an 82-slot batch inside the diversity caps — and RC2.6 closes that by ADDING ten genuinely hard structures in the five families the calibration had emptied, plus one further demotion (MACH_H_TWO_CONFIG) resolved by direct sampling. Production necessarily moves past it.

entries.reason: RC2.7 changes production source (composition layer, scenario and realization rendering, novelty scheduler, sequence rule space). The RC2.6 freeze is archived intact so the engine it certified stays identifiable; a new freeze is taken at the end of RC2.7.

An independent review failed RC2.7 for perceived diversity (4.2/10 overall, 2.8/10 all-hard) and located the cause: scenario, noun, name, number and order changes moved the internal signatures while the equation, the requested target and the solution path stayed the same. Production moves again to fix that, so the RC2.7 freeze is archived intact.
